lines.t: Your sure is my shepherd, I shall not want, I shall not lack
He makes me lie down in green pastures
Leads me by still waters, brings me back
He restores my soul, restores my soul
Guides me in paths of righteousness
For His name's sake, for His holy name
Yeshua HaMashiach, my King, my Redeemer
Forever your mercy endures, your truth ascends high
Holy, holy, holy is your name
Let all the earth sing praise to you
Come out, come out, my people come
Worship in spirit, worship in truth
The Father seeks such as these
Yahshua is King
Yahshua is King
Yahushua HaMashiach
The Holy One of Israel
For He is who He is and there is none like Him
Says the Lord
Behold, I stand at the door and knock
Hear my voice, open wide the door
I will come and dine with you, you with me
Overcome and sit upon my throne as I overcame
I sat with my Father forever in glory, forever in white
I am the way, the truth, the life
No one comes to the Father but through me
Return to me with all your heart
I blot out transgressions, remember no more
Yahushua, shepherd of the flock
One flock, one shepherd, forevermore
And they shall all become one flock
With one shepherd, behold, I shall be their God
And they shall be my people forever
Says the Lord
Yeshua HaMashiach, my King, my Redeemer
Forever your mercy endures
Your truth ascends high
Holy, holy, holy is your name
Let all the earth sing praise to you
Come out, come out, my people come
Worship in spirit, worship in truth
The Father seeks such as these
Yahshua is King
Yahshua is King
Yahshua is King
Forever
